'''Gelan Yees'''<ref name="Card Trader" /> was a [[Sabat]] who served in the [[Cloud-Riders]] under the command of [[Enfys Nest]]. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Yees participated in a [[Showdown on Savareen|skirmish]] with [[Crimson Dawn]] on [[Savareen]].<ref name="Solo" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gelan Yees was portrayed by [[Dilu Miah]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|deetails|status/1018874896699609090|[[Dee Tails]]|quote=Yeah, Regineer Teed, is me. Gelan Yees, Dilu Miah. Auromae Iselo, Derek Arnold. Tubes, Aiden Cook aka Two Tubes. Silvasu Fi, Stephanie Silva. Faddera Rabar, Barbara Fadden.Other than Warrick (Weazel) and Erin (Enfys) the others are stuntmen and women.|archivedate=20181030063907 }}</ref> in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was identified later that year by by the ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]'' app.<ref name="Card Trader" />
